label: the leap crew
note: Races 4 and 5: the top rung of the race ladder, three locals who race out of Farleap village on the far side of the planet, the furthest place from the port, on the Far Leaps: two tunnels through the far mountains and rows of jump ramps (Skrugs's own ramp, placed by the course file) on the stretches between. They only race you once you have beaten the crag crew (`after`). The best there is: three fully stacked racers, the best drivers on the planet at the yoke (skill pro), every piece of race gear, shooting from lap 1. Same shape as yard.json (read its note); the hangout frame's +x faces their start line.

lines.slips_accept: Pink slips? Ha. Winner drives home in both.
lines.no_room: Where would you even park it? Your row's full.
lines.slips_not_yours: Bet a ride that isn't yours yet? Shake whoever owns it first, then we talk slips.
lines.slips_won: {ride} is yours. It's waiting outside the back gate.
lines.slips_lost: They drive off in your speeder. Win it back: race them for pink slips again.
challenge: Nobody comes this far out just to look. You want the Far Leaps?
Two tunnels and the ramps. Hit them flat out or don't hit them at all. We shoot from the start.
lines.menu_body: {course}: {laps} laps through the gates. {rule} Winner takes {multiple} times the buy-in. Your best lap here: {best}.
lines.rule_shoot: From lap {lap} it gets rough: we shoot.
lines.too_poor: {stake} credits, minimum. Come back when you've got it.
lines.no_speeder: Race us on what, your feet? Bring a speeder.
lines.accept: Done. Get to the line. Don't keep the crowd waiting.
lines.comms: We'll be on your comms. Try not to scream on the jumps.
lines.go_line: Get to the start line by the antennas
taunts: See you on the other side of the jump.
jeers: Still in front? Not for long!
lines.leader_lost: You flew it like you were born out here. Again some time.
lines.leader_won: The leaps sort the drivers from the passengers.
lines.not_yet: The crag crew first. If you can't turn, you can't fly.
lines.next_crew: That's it. You beat every crew on this planet. Nobody else to race but us again.
